purpose: Persist R2E production defects and their permanent automated controls; this is operational evidence rather than conversational memory.

incidents.symptom: R2E rejected a successful HKEX cross-check because the workflow asserted status == PASS while the accepted R2D adapter emits PASS_REFERENCE_CONSISTENT.
incidents.root_cause: A downstream workflow duplicated an upstream component's status literal instead of binding to canonical upstream status semantics.
incidents.permanent_control: R2E asserts PASS_REFERENCE_CONSISTENT plus publication_allowed=true and primary_authority_unchanged=true.
incidents.regression_control: Downstream workflows consume canonical upstream status semantics; stale shorthand status literals are prohibited.

incidents.symptom: A completed-session FMDL-5C build labelled for 2026-08-06 contained Yahoo/Eastmoney price data through the still-open 2026-08-07 session.
incidents.root_cause: Yahoo chart requests intentionally extend period2 beyond end_date and the Eastmoney fallback endpoint requests an open-ended range; changing date.today() alone therefore did not enforce a physical market-data cutoff.
incidents.permanent_control: The R2E refresh adapter hard-filters every Yahoo/Eastmoney observation after the completed-session cutoff before FMDL-5C quality/decision files are built; HKMA FX and dated corporate actions are also cutoff-filtered.
incidents.regression_control: Unit tests require rows after the cutoff to be removed; remote Run #18 independently verifies both FMDL5C_DECISION.metrics.max_market_date and the physical parquet maximum date equal 2026-08-06, with FMDL-5E future price rows = 0.

incidents.symptom: The optional HKEX current-action overlay treated a successfully parsed official table with zero relevant non-New-Listing events as a hard failure.
incidents.root_cause: The repair script collapsed two distinct conditions: parser/structure failure versus a valid zero-result after universe filtering.
incidents.permanent_control: R2E distinguishes HKEX_ACTION_TABLE_NOT_FOUND from HKEX_CURRENT_ACTIONS_EMPTY_AFTER_SUCCESSFUL_PARSE. The latter is accepted as PASS_ZERO_RELEVANT_EVENTS and leaves the already accepted base FMDL-5C candidate unchanged.
incidents.regression_control: Run #18 records hkex_current_action_overlay.status=PASS_ZERO_RELEVANT_EVENTS while FMDL-5C remains accepted and FMDL-5E future action rows remain zero.

non_negotiable_policies: A release label or requested end date is not proof of point-in-time cleanliness; the physical maximum observation date must be independently checked.
During an open Hong Kong session, research factors must use the latest completed Stock Connect service day rather than the partial current session.
A valid zero-result is not the same as a parser failure; zero-result semantics must be explicit in the source contract.
A previously accepted same-date R2C forward-complete state may bridge a transient same-date notice-index refresh degradation, but never a later as-of date.
Fresh R2E evidence may be built on a PR runner, but upstream FMDL-5C/FMDL-5E Current and HKCU Canonical are not published before R2F.
No candidate, simulation, real-account or order mutation is permitted in R2E.
